At a glance

The 22 kW version with a CEE 32 A plug: Type 2 socket with a lock on the unit, Wi-Fi, RFID and OCPP 1.6J. The Type 2 cable to the car is sold separately.

  • Up to 22 kW from a three-phase 32 A CEE socket (red, 5-pin); no installation needed.
  • The unit has a Type 2 socket, so you also need a Type 2 cable to the car.
  • Adapters for CEE 16 A, blue CEE and Schuko sockets are sold separately.
  • RFID reader: charging starts with your card, handy in a shared garage.
  • Wi-Fi, OCPP 1.6J.
  • Made in Austria.

In the box
